purpose: Add a source-traceable Fanny Crosby hymn with public-domain lyrics, playable notation, and presentation-ready text.
guardrails: Lyrics were transcribed line by line from the cited public-domain hymnal record without modernization.
The tune and SATB MIDI come from the exact Mutopia piece directory.
The Mutopia MIDI and RDF are retained locally and verified by SHA-256.
The RDF Public Domain declaration must match the hymn music-rights field.
No historical or modern audio recording is included or implied to be reusable.

entries.title: Blessed Assurance
entries.text_source_edition: Hymnal for Church and Home, second edition, 1928, hymn 333
entries.presentation_use: Three stanza slides with the public-domain refrain and a title slide linked to KJV Scripture references.
entries.recording_scope: The in-app Web Audio playback is synthesized from the retained public-domain MIDI. No third-party performance recording is copied.
